description: Eliminate remaining n512 host/Python survivor-mask and eigen-position metadata work on the integrated best: persist flags, counts, compact indices, and workspace in the extension; fuse initial eigen-position classification with CUB compaction or its consuming repair launch; preserve exact survivor selection, width-16 generalized repair, certificates, fallbacks, n1024 geometric repair, every size route, and CUDA guards; profile launch/API deltas and target spectra.

Moved n512 initial/refinement flags, mapped counts, ordered compact indices, survivor state, and seven matrix/value workspaces into one grow-only extension state. Replaced both ATen nonzero stages with ordered CUB scans, fused remaining failure and eigen-position classification into one scan, removed Python bit masks/advanced survivor selection, and fused repaired-survivor update with exact fallback compaction. Preserved width-16 generalized repair, recertification, fallback order, n1024 geometric repair, and all routes. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23681.959891 us versus parent 23715.464526; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57474.241/98213.674/95514.966/122902.985/55737.792 us.

Kept n512 generalized-repair flags entirely inside persistent stage-0 recertification state and replaced three Python advanced-index scatters of corrected vectors, Rayleigh values, and flags with one extension kernel keyed by the already compacted second-stage positions. Final survivor compaction now reads persistent flags directly; Python no longer handles remaining or repair flag masks. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23721.112068 us versus trial-0 23681.959891 and parent 23715.464526, within documented noise; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57530.407/98812.146/95443.489/122911.275/55721.354 us. Mixed and n1024-mixed adaptive repeats showed elevated run variance.

Parallelized the extension-owned second-repair merge across eight CTAs per corrected matrix and copied aligned vector storage as float4, retaining internal recertification flags and exact compact positions while avoiding the prior one-CTA 512x512 copy bottleneck. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23704.442471 us versus one-CTA trial 23721.112068, trial-0 23681.959891, and parent 23715.464526. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even measured 57469.705/98197.179/95488.292/122912.628/55805.461 us; mixed improved 0.62% over the one-CTA trial and matched trial-0 within noise.

Fused each n512 compact-index vector/value scatter pair into one extension-owned eight-CTA-per-matrix float4 kernel: the post-Newton refinement scatter consumes persistent unsafe indices directly in C++, and the generalized-repair scatter consumes persistent repair indices without Python advanced indexing. Exact order, values, width-16 repair, survivor selection, and fallbacks are unchanged. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23665.577063 us, brief-best versus trial-0 23681.959891 and parent 23715.464526. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57345.056/97981.908/95259.712/123006.569/55808.351 us; mixed improved 215.271 us and rankdef 228.580 us versus trial 2.

Selected valid commit 8a7c8962bae250b4193820dbb3915154ed43c6fc. Four committed trials moved n512 initial/refinement flags, mapped counts, ordered unsafe/remaining/repair/fallback indices, survivor state, and matrix/value workspaces into a grow-only extension state; fused remaining/eigen classification with ordered CUB compaction; removed Python nonzero, bit masks, survivor mutation, and repair-flag handling; merged second-stage vector/value/flag updates; and fused compact-index vector/value scatters. Trial metrics were 23681.959891, 23721.112068, 23704.442471, and a brief-best 23665.577063 us; selected-SHA replay measured 23676.318724 us, a 0.045% spread and 0.21% below parent 23715.464526. Final cached build and kernelguard passed, validation passed all 39/39 stress cases, and both full 13-shape benchmarks passed. Selected n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even were 57345.056/97981.908/95259.712/123006.569/55808.351 us; replay was 57321.462/98131.105/95306.669/122980.298/55743.488 us. Final committed mixed nsys profile has 3004 cudaLaunchKernel versus parent 3028, four cudaMemcpyAsync versus eight, and seven total synchronization calls versus eight; persistent compaction kernels total 11.7 us, fused scatters 164.1 us, and second-repair merge 21.3 us. Dense-even profile has 90 launches, 2.88 us initial and remaining compactions, and a 20.64 us fused scatter with no generalized-repair launches. Width-16 generalized repair, exact ordered fallback selection, certificates, n1024 geometric repair, every size route, and CUDA guards remain intact. Keep the run moving by making the remaining final cuSOLVER fallback scatter consume strided solver output in one extension kernel, moving the second-stage gather/correction count fully device-side to remove another mapped-count synchronization, or carving the small width-16 eig/whitening outputs from persistent state; fixed-capacity device-count execution and a focused CPU/PyTorch metadata trace are also open. Final mixed and dense-even profiles are SHA-named under autocuda/profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25. No leaderboard submission was made.

Stage-0 flags remain device-resident; fixed-count Gram/Newton/certificate launches cover every generalized-repair candidate, stage 1 masks certification with stage-0 flags, merge overwrites only active candidates, and final ordered compaction combines stage-0/stage-1 flags. Removed the CUB recertification scan, mapped host/device count, two second-stage gathers, and redundant pre-certificate AQ product. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23666.205886 us versus selected 23665.577063/replay 23676.318724. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57417.206/97791.821/95160.255/122990.412/55722.762 us; mixed and rankdef improve 190.087/99.457 us versus selected measurement while aggregate remains within noise.

Replaced the final n512 cuSOLVER fallback's two Python advanced-index scatters with one extension kernel. A 32x32 padded shared tile reads the solver's transposed logical view coalesced through its row/column strides, writes row-major destination tiles by persistent ordered fallback index, and copies eigenvalues in the same launch. Exact fallback set/order and solver results are unchanged. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23662.125131 us versus device-count trial 23666.205886 and selected 23665.577063. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57335.467/97575.956/95178.017/122987.180/55713.984 us; mixed improves another 215.865 us versus trial 4 while aggregate remains within documented noise.

Carved the width-16 generalized eigensolve and whitening chain into extension-owned grow-only scratch: five [repair*32,16,16] matrices plus eigenvalue/scale vectors are reused by lifetime for raw/symmetric Gram and projected matrices, whitening, reduced solve, and final rotation. Both torch.linalg.eigh calls remain library-owned through out= buffers; bmm/add/mul/clamp/rsqrt intermediates now use persistent outputs. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23665.275388 us versus strided-scatter trial 23662.125131 and selected 23665.577063, within noise. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57319.353/97614.932/95140.513/122995.702/55783.574 us; numerical routes and fallback selection remain unchanged.

Added an environment-gated one-shot CPU/PyTorch allocation trace around the n512 batch-640 route to measure remaining ATen metadata and temporary allocation events without changing the default production path. Disabled mode passed cached build/kernelguard and validation 39/39. Disabled full metric 23687.423063 us versus cumulative production trial 23665.275388, within run variance; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57417.632/97721.792/95068.158/122979.787/55753.578 us. This committed trace harness is temporary and will be removed after the requested mixed-spectrum allocator/nsys capture.

Default mode is unchanged. Cached build/kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full disabled metric 23662.590060 us versus production trial 23665.275388 and trace trial 23687.423063; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57367.254/97523.908/95257.431/122965.299/55726.699 us.

Removed all temporary CPU allocator instrumentation, leaving a production tree byte-identical to cumulative trial 6: device-side fixed-capacity second repair, fused strided cuSOLVER fallback scatter, and persistent width-16 scratch. Cached build/kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 23684.174332 us versus identical-tree trial 6 at 23665.275388 and trace-disabled trial 8 at 23662.590060, within run variance driven by n1024 mixed; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57374.951/97603.742/95268.906/122985.502/55716.927 us.

Selected cumulative production commit 24f5c16b81d262f6a30605cdb71a54224acf0f43. Continuation trial 4 removed the mapped second-stage recertification count by fixed-capacity device-side execution and measured 23666.205886 us; trial 5 fused the final cuSOLVER fallback's strided vectors and values into one ordered extension scatter and measured the continuation-best logged 23662.125131 us; trial 6 persisted five width-16 matrices plus eigenvalue/scale scratch and measured 23665.275388 us. Temporary trials 7/8 captured cold and warm PyTorch metadata and were removed completely in trial 9. Final production measurement was 23684.174332 us and the selected-SHA replay was 23662.301666 us, confirming the first result's unchanged n1024-mixed variance; replay is 3.275 us below the prior selected 23665.577063 and 14.017 us below its 23676.318724 replay. Final cached build/kernelguard passed and validation passed all 39/39 cases. Replay n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even was 57292.447/97547.838/95207.774/123019.605/55736.107 us. The warm allocation trace reduced recurring aten::empty/empty_strided/resize_ to 18/9/1 from brief 58's 24/10/11 post-recertification trace and 39/19/17 pre-persistence trace; width-16 bmm/add/mul/clamp/rsqrt/eigh shapes show supplied outputs. Final mixed nsys reports 3002 cudaLaunchKernel, 92 cuLaunchKernelEx, three cudaDeviceSynchronize, three cudaStreamSynchronize, and four cudaMemcpyAsync calls versus prior selected 3004/93/four/three/four, so the continuation removes one mapped-count device synchronization and two net runtime launches. The one strided fallback scatter costs 62.176 us; two compact-index scatters total 163.072 us, second-repair merge 22.112 us, and the three ordered compactions 9.888 us. Profiles are SHA-named under autocuda/profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25. Width-16 generalized repair, exact ordered survivor/fallback selection, certificates, n1024 geometric repair, all size routes, and CUDA guards remain intact. Concrete next directions are moving the n512 concentration/library_count branch into the extension to remove its Python scalar synchronization, converting the initial candidate and final fallback host-count reads to device-controlled fixed-capacity launches, and tracing the remaining 18 warm empty events, especially the 640x8 clone/empty_like tail and library eigensolver metadata. No leaderboard submission was made.

Made compact-WY construction consume strided tau slices directly and alias its fully consumed Gram input as T output. This removes five tau contiguous clones and five compact-WY empty_like outputs per warm n512 call, including the [640,8] clone and [640,8,8] tail output, while retaining identical shared-memory arithmetic. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23736.715993 us versus selected replay 23662.301666; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57967.328/98244.321/95597.099/123010.666/56466.614 us. The recurring-allocation reduction carries a roughly 0.5-1.3% n512 cache/lifetime cost in this measurement.

Separated the compact-WY aliasing and strided-input effects: restored a distinct empty_like T output while retaining direct strided tau reads, removing only the five tau clones. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23740.901756 us, essentially matching in-place trial 10 at 23736.715993 rather than selected replay 23662.301666. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57897.560/98474.171/95758.067/123007.123/56319.871 us. The persistent elevation after restoring T storage attributes the measured cost to scattered tau access; compact contiguous staging will be restored in the next production change.

Restored selected compact-WY staging and moved the n512 diagonal-concentration all-library decision into one extension kernel plus extension-owned mapped state. The extension performs the route branch and invokes cuSOLVER itself for homogeneous library batches; Python receives either solved eigenpairs or an empty host vector and no longer creates diagonal/reduction/mask/conversion tensors or extracts a CUDA scalar. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39 including extreme spectra. Full metric 23687.975235 us versus selected replay 23662.301666; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57801.301/97963.005/95619.199/122785.238/56252.810 us. Per-matrix atomics to mapped host state remain a measurable classifier cost and motivate device-side aggregation.

Moved n512 classifier aggregation off mapped host memory: persistent extension-owned device state receives all per-matrix atomic decisions, followed by one four-byte async copy into pinned host state at the unchanged route synchronization. The extension-owned route branch and exact concentration thresholds remain unchanged. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23654.711463 us, below selected production replay 23662.301666 and mapped-atomic trial 23687.975235. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 57159.669/97687.353/94960.617/122776.896/55632.928 us; four of five targets improve versus selected replay while mixed remains within variance.

Removed the initial-candidate host count read and its device synchronization. Ordered CUB compaction now feeds fixed-capacity device-count-gated gather, Newton correction, round-3 snapshot, exact round-3/5/6 selection, certificate, scatter, and remaining compaction launches; BMMs execute at batch capacity, and the candidate count is read only at the already-required post-refinement synchronization. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39 with unchanged count-dependent numerical policy. Full metric 23951.128785 us versus device-classifier trial 23654.711463. n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 60675.723/99223.039/96477.313/122853.696/59739.520 us. Removing the sync costs 3.5-4.1 ms on sparse-candidate dense routes and 1.5-1.8 ms on mixed/rankdef through fixed-capacity BMM work.

Survivor compaction feeds an unconditional full-batch cuSOLVER call; one fixed-capacity strided scatter reads counts[3] and either replaces all matrices for broad fallback or only exact ordered fallback indices otherwise. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 26844.164984 us versus classifier best 23654.711463. Mixed/rankdef n512 rise from 97687.353/94960.617 to 217695.531/221511.882 us because fixed capacity solves all 640 matrices for sparse survivor sets; dense/clustered/dense-even remain 57111.071/122844.577/55598.517 us.

Survivor compaction now records source positions; when remaining_count is below the 75% threshold, which proves broad fallback impossible, cuSOLVER processes that fixed-capacity set and the device-count scatter copies only compacted survivors. Larger upper bounds retain full-batch solve plus the exact device broad/selective branch. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23748.663106 us versus full-batch fixed trial 26844.164984 and classifier best 23654.711463. Mixed n512 drops from 217695.531 to 104059.657 us but remains 6372.304 us above best from solving all 88 remaining matrices; rankdef 94904.129 us matches best within noise. Dense/clustered/dense-even 57154.657/122860.875/55501.504 us.

This removes the safe fallback empty_like/empty result allocations while retaining the same input copy, solver capacity, ordered survivor positions, and device-count scatter. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 23765.396066 us versus fixed-capacity trial 23748.663106 and classifier best 23654.711463; mixed n512 improves 253.736 us to 103805.921, rankdef remains 94964.874, and aggregate variation comes from unchanged small/n1024 routes. Dense/clustered/dense-even 57133.120/122915.263/55565.056 us.

Validation 39/39; mixed 97559.545 us versus 97676.575 us production replay.

Validation 39/39, but n512 remains 0.55-0.73 ms slower (dense 57715.338, mixed 97839.584, rankdef 95564.565, dense-even 56125.921 us), so Gram aliasing is also rejected.

Restore exact trial-20 production source after compact-WY allocation isolation. Validation 39/39; n512 dense 57139.201, mixed 97775.219, rankdef 94997.803, clustered 122838.977, dense-even 55596.335 us. Aggregate replay variance leaves identical-source trial 20 as measured winner at 23627.380316.
